summary: This section explains how the Central Government gives a special identification number to a person who wants to be a director. The government has one month to finish this task after receiving the application. The process for giving this number must follow the set rules.
points: An application is made under section 153.
The Central Government must allot a Director Identification Number to the applicant.
The time limit for this allotment is within one month from receiving the application.
The allotment must follow the prescribed manner.
example: Aarav decided to apply for a Director Identification Number so he could join the board of an enterprise named Zenith Innovations Private Limited. He correctly submitted his application under section 153 to the Central Government. The government received his papers and started the review process. According to the law, the Central Government has a period of one month from the day they got Aarav's application to allot him the Director Identification Number following the official rules.

terms.meaning: A unique identifying number given to a person who is or wants to be a director of a company.
To give or assign something officially.
Decided or ordered by official rules.

watch: Make sure not to confuse the one-month time limit for the government to give the number with any other application deadlines.
